verdict.rationale: Logseq's Publishing feature turns a graph into a browsable single-page web app. Nothing is public by default, and individual pages are opted in with `publish:: true` (logseq-docs-14, logseq-docs-7), which covers publishing selected notes. A long-time user also praises the publishing features (logseq-comm-16). missing for 10: explicit evidence that links between published pages work, documentation of hosting/deployment and whether the whole flow stays inside the app, independent hands-on corroboration of the published site's quality.
